staticText: Local-first provenance review for 308 name records across 20 unverified listed-language labels. Search, browse, visible-result export and a six-record session shortlist operate without persistence or network access.
boundaries: Do not invent or infer meanings, ethnic ownership, country, community, gender, pronunciation, popularity or cultural significance.
A listed language label is not proof of country, community or exclusive cultural ownership.
Do not describe the records as verified names and meanings until community-backed per-entry sources are added.
The route dataset intentionally contains only name and listedLanguage fields; unsupported legacy meanings, gender, popularity and theme fields were removed.
A session shortlist is a comparison aid only and must not be described as a cultural recommendation or naming decision.
Never place searched names or results in browser persistence, URLs, analytics, accounts, email, logs or caches.
